div.div:
Provisioning uses bootstrap images; deployment replaces explicit entrypoints and synchronizes the refresh image. Wait for ready revisions before smoke tests.
Resource group, remote state, network and DNS are external prerequisites. The authorized SecurityControl=Ignore demo tag is not production guidance.
